row: Sherman College of Chiropractic offers a first professional degree program leading to the doctor of chiropractic degree. Renowned globally for its unique approach to health care, the college is committed to producing doctors who are highly skilled in detecting and correcting vertebral subluxations and are compassionate, ethical, and successful. Sherman College emphasizes a comprehensive chiropractic education by diligently teaching the philosophy and principles that distinguish chiropractic as a separate and distinct profession. Through innovative teaching methods, students become well-versed in the philosophy, science, art, and business of chiropractic, ensuring professional fulfillment and practice success as they serve communities worldwide. Students receive hands-on experience in the college's on-campus Chiropractic Center, with senior students gaining hands-on experience under the careful supervision of licensed doctors of chiropractic. Visit www.sherman.edu for more information.
